text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"This is a show, a challenge, and a matter 
of pride dedicated to you and my beloved 
junior."

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-senpaaaai! You're gorgeous even 
through a screen~!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean she's going to show us her 
back? Wow, what if she actually wins?!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if that happens, maybe I'll try 
aiming for the Triple Crown route too~! 
Even though I'm no good on turf!

text_block_list.name: Dark Bay Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"If it were that easy to overcome, there's 
no way I would've given up in the first 
place..."

The stands are filled with a mix of 
anticipation and anxiety. Meanwhile, Fuji 
Kiseki was answering questions in a 
pre-race press scrum.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
“—In a previous press conference, you 
stated that your aptitude leaned toward 
the mile, but...”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The other contenders are 
formidable as it is, so I don't expect it 
to be an easy race.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even so, today is a medium-distance 2,400 
meters! Although it's 400 meters longer 
than the Satsuki Sho, I believe we still 
have a fighting chance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
3000m in the fall is quite long after all, 
...maybe I should think up some kind of 
magic trick.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thank you very much! Now then, 
could you share a few final words about 
your determination?!

Prompted like that, Fuji Kiseki stares 
straight into the ready camera.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is... the second peak I've been 
aiming for. A race of possibilities, 
dedicated to you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Please don't look away. Look forward to 
what's in store!"

With those words, rose petals completely 
covered the screen— and the press scrum 
came to an end.

A pinnacle GⅠ race full of nothing but 
monsters—the curtain rises on the Nippon 
Derby!
